headline: Approved sign variance at 869 Eastern Ave and reversed 2001 variance condition at 134-136 Wyoming Ave
summary: The Board of Appeal approved a reduced wall sign variance for F.W. Webb Company at 869 Eastern Ave. The board also approved reversing a 2001 variance decision and rescinding condition four for a property at 134-136 Wyoming Ave.
decisions: Approved the minutes from the June 17, 2026 meeting.
Approved Petition 26-005 for a wall sign variance at 869 Eastern Ave, Malden, MA, choosing Option C at 60.6 Sq. Ft, by a vote of 5-0.
Approved Petition 26-006 to reverse the 2001 variance and rescind condition four for the property at 134-136 Wyoming Ave, Malden, MA, by a vote of 5-0.

decision_evidence.quote: Motion by King to approve the minutes from the June 17, 2026, meeting, 2nd by Sherwin - All in favor.
Motion by Bilgen to approve Option C - 60.6 Sq. Ft, 2nd by King: Bilgen -Yes, King - Yes, Yu - Yes, Sherwin - Yes, Cramer - Yes. By a vote of 5-0, Petition 26-005 has been approved.

Motion by Sherwin to the reversal of the 2001 variance and rescind condition four, 2nd by Bilgen: Bilgen - Yes, King - Yes, Yu - Yes, Sherwin - Yes, Cramer - Yes. By a vote of 5-0, Petition 26-006 has been approved.

City of Malden
Massachusetts
Board of Appeal

Malden, Massachusetts 02148

Board of Appeal - Public Meeting
July 15, 2026
Minutes
The Malden Board of Appeal held a Public Hearing Wednesday July 15, 2026, at 6:30 pm at
Malden City Hall, 215 Pleasant St., Room #106 Herbert L Jackson Council Chambers, Malden,
MA on the following named petitions:
    Roll Call: Bilgen, Cramer, D'Esposito, King, Sherwin and Yu. 
    Stephen Froio was absent. In Froio's absence Alex Yu was appointed to serve as a voting
member. 
    Minutes: Motion by King to approve the minutes from the June 17, 2026, meeting, 2nd by
Sherwin -      All in favor. 
Petition 26-005 by F.W. Webb Company  seeking a variance under Code of the City of Malden
as amended - Title 4 Section 4.16.090 (c) (2) (a) Table of Intensity Regulations: Specifically:
Wall sign exceeding 40  as per plans SGER-076380-2026  at the property known as and
numbered 869 Eastern Ave., Malden, MA and also known by City Assessor's Parcel ID
#127-435-504
Petition 26-005 is being represented by Ed Spinney from Sign Art. This petition was tabled from
the June 17, 2026, meeting so that new plans could be submitted by reducing the size of the
sign.
The new plans consisted of 3 options, Option A - 74.95 Sq Ft, Option B - 67.9 Sq. Ft, and 
Option C - 60.6 Sq. Ft.
No one appeared in support or opposition.
Motion by Bilgen to approve Option C - 60.6 Sq. Ft, 2nd by King: Bilgen -Yes, King - Yes, Yu -
Yes,
Sherwin - Yes, Cramer - Yes.  By a vote of 5-0, Petition 26-005 has been approved. 
Petition 26-006 by Franz Marenghi seeking a Revision to condition 4 of a variance decision
recorded by City Clerk, September 26, 2001, at the property known as and numbered 134 -
136 Wyoming Ave, Malden, MA and also known by City Assessor's Parcel ID #007 063 311 
Petition 26-006 is being represented by Attorney Chris Fallon.
Attorney Fallon stated that with the variance, they are unable to obtain title insurance to sell the
property.
Chairman Cramer said this is a condition that was placed on the property that never should
have been placed there to begin with, the variance goes with the land not the owner. 
No one appeared in opposition, we did receive a letter of support from City Council President,   
       Ward 3 Councillor, Amanda Linehan. 
Motion by Sherwin to the reversal of the 2001 variance and rescind condition four, 2nd by
Bilgen:           Bilgen - Yes, King - Yes, Yu - Yes, Sherwin - Yes, Cramer - Yes. By a vote of 5-0,
Petition 26-006 has been approved. 
Motion by Sherwin to adjourn, 2nd by King - All in favor. Adjourned at 6:49 pm.
